profile.name: Pete Hegseth
profile.description: Defense secretary with direct responsibility for military AI adoption; reported White House task-force member.

web.named_query: ("Emil Michael" OR "Pete Hegseth") AI artificial intelligence superintelligence policy statements

summary.text: In supplied remarks, Hegseth described responsible AI at the War Department as objectively truthful, securely employed, and lawful, while rejecting DEI and social justice constraints and saying the department will not use models that won't allow it to fight wars. He framed military AI as a race in which moving too slowly risks national security, and he called for acceleration, experimentation, and an AI-first warfighting force. He announced GenAI.mil as a secure generative AI platform and later announced Google Gemini and xAI's Grok as frontier AI model partners for the department. He also said U.S. policy is to sustain and enhance global AI dominance and that the department must ensure U.S. military AI dominance so adversaries cannot exploit the technology against national security interests or citizens.

statements.text: Fifth, responsible AI. Today I want to clarify what responsible AI means at the Department of War. Gone are the days of equitable AI and other DEI and social justice infusions that constrain and confuse our employment of this technology. Effective immediately, responsible AI at the War Department means objectively truthful AI capabilities employed securely and within the laws governing the activities of the department. We will not employ AI models that won't allow you to fight wars.
